tests.name: unit suite (vitest)
tests.reason: Member names and avatars open the profile on about 15 screens. Staging is read-only and shares the production database, so the behaviour is pinned by vitest: member-link.test.tsx (target, stopPropagation, keyboard, no-id case), profile-path.test.ts, and the recurrence guard src/lib/__guards__/member-link.guard.test.ts (fails on any new unlinked member avatar not on the reviewed allowlist).
